name: Goop
abilities: Shapeshifting and elasticity (any shape, pseudopods, slips under doors)
Regeneration - reforms after being bisected, splattered or even atomised across a planet's ocean
Acidic cytoplasm (self-acidification, acid projectiles, can neutralise it)
Flight and levitation via Anti-Gravity Projector (which can also be thrown as a blade)
Feels little pain; can hold people inside his body
weaknesses: Anti-Gravity Projector is a vulnerable target - grabbed, shot or switched off, he collapses into a helpless puddle
Being spun in a centrifuge or teleported would separate/destroy him
Vaporised by Ultimate Galvan energy beams
Can be hypnotised and affected by Nemuina sleeping dust
summary: A 200-pound single-celled blob held together by a floating anti-gravity disc; nearly impossible to hurt but helpless without the disc.
traits: Held together by an Anti-Gravity Projector
Coloured all of Piscciss's water green
notableFeats: Defeated a Techadon Robot in his debut (The Gauntlet)
Wrestled and beat Prior Gahlil (Darkstar Rising)
Ben turned Vilgax into Goop to yank the Omnitrix off him (Primus)
Pulled the shattered planet Piscciss back together after being atomised across its ocean (Deep)
Saved Blukic and Driba from Trombipulor (Blukic and Driba Go to Mr. Smoothy's)

appearances.designNotes: Green translucent gelatinous humanoid with bright green eyes, hovering Anti-Gravity Projector above; recalibrated Omnitrix symbol on chest.
Same design as Alien Force with the Ultimatrix symbol on chest. Heroes United cameo had thicker eye outlines.

appearances.firstEpisode: Blukic and Driba Go to Mr. Smoothy's
notableEpisodes: Blukic and Driba Go to Mr. Smoothy's
It's a Mad, Mad, Mad Ben World: Part 1
appearances.designNotes: Amoeba-like silhouette with a nose-like beak, redesigned Anti-Gravity Projector carrying the Omnitrix symbol on top.

scoring.rationale: Near-unkillable: reforms from bisection, splatter and planet-wide atomisation (regeneration 9), slips through anything and can turn acidic. Hits are soft and his whole existence depends on the Anti-Gravity Projector - remove it and he is a puddle (weaknessPenalty 3).

notes: Homeworld: Polymorphs' native planet was destroyed/unknown; they now live on Viscosia (wiki lists both).
Also used by Albedo (Negative Goop) and Vilgax (Primus).
OV Ben Again use was 11-year-old Ben's mind in 16-year-old Ben's body (counted as ben-16-ov).
AF S1 (wiki) = ben-15-af, AF S2 = ben-16-af.
